claude.sample_unit: de-identified dental EMRs converted to synthetic Mandarin dialogues (50-case expert-rated subset)

links.outcome: Expert-rated quality (7DI incl. accuracy, completeness) of ambient-scribe-style dental notes across models and prompts
links.effect: Blinded experts scored 600 EMRs on 7 dimensions; CRISPE prompt 7DI 28.86±2.12 vs basic 26.91±2.36 (p<.001); no significant differences between models (ANOVA F=0.54, p=.744).
links.quote: The CRISPE strategy significantly outperformed the basic prompt across all models (Mean 7DI: 28.86 ± 2.12 vs. 26.91 ± 2.36; p<.001).

unlisted_practices: Structured prompt engineering (CRISPE framework) to improve AI-generated clinical documentation
Locally deployable open-source LLMs for privacy-preserving documentation

openai.sample_unit: de-identified dental EMR cases converted to synthetic dialogues

links.effect: CRISPE improved total 7DI: 28.86 ± 2.12 vs. 26.91 ± 2.36; p < .001; d = 0.57.
links.quote: As detailed in Table 3 , the CRISPE framework yielded a highly significant improvement in overall 7DI scores (28.86 ± 2.12 vs. 26.91 ± 2.36; p < .001, Cohen’s d = 0.57).

links.effect: Automated metrics differed significantly; expert 7DI found no significant between-model differences: F = 0.21, p = .957, η² = 0.009.
links.quote: ANOVA detected no statistically significant differences among models (F = 0.21, p = .957, η² = 0.009), and all post-hoc Tukey HSD pairwise comparisons were non-significant (all p > .05).

links.effect: All dialogues were Mandarin; expert total 7DI under CRISPE ranged 28.54 to 29.22 out of 35 across models.
links.quote: Across models, performance remained high, suggesting substantial cross-linguistic transfer in this controlled setting.

links.effect: Under CRISPE, total 7DI ranged 28.54–29.22/35; Accuracy scores ranged 3.78–3.98/5 across models.
links.quote: Despite high accuracy, we must acknowledge the inherent risk of hallucination.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating locally deployable open-source LLMs as alternatives to proprietary cloud LLMs for dental EMR generation
